{{Top}}
{{MultipleIssues|Expand|Citation}}
{{Quote|Agrirobots require constant maintenance, Jawas don't know a pika fruit from a rainbow berry, and all the local kids are just daydreamers who want to be starfighter pilots.|[[Huff Darklighter]]|<ref name="SWG:FC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Farmers' Champion}}</ref>}}
[[File:NysillinHarvest-BH.png|thumb|right|280px|[[Akira/Legends|Akira]], a [[Nysillin/Legends|nysillin]] farm on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]]]
A '''farm''', or '''farmstead''', was a piece of land used for various agricultural purposes. Farms on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] grew crops.<ref name="Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> Dry, desert worlds, such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] had [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farms]], where [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporators]] harvested [[Water/Legends|water]] from the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Moisture farmers either used this water themselves, such as to irrigate crops grown in underground gardens, for personal water consumption, or to sell for profit.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

[[Cut Lawquane/Legends|Cut Lawquane]] and his [[Lawquane family/Legends|family]] tended a [[Lawquane farmstead|farm]] on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Deserter">{{TCW|The Deserter}}</ref>
